verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents llmster, a headless daemon that runs without the desktop app (lm-studio-docs-8, docs-31), which addresses the complaint that the full Electron UI had to be running (lm-studio-comm-13). It also offers on-demand model loading (docs-30), but nothing in the evidence claims or measures a fast cold start or a small binary footprint. missing for 10: any documented or measured cold-start/startup latency, evidence that llmster is a lightweight binary, independent or hands-on corroboration of fast time-to-first-inference.
